audit_findings.title: 2028 JAKAFI cliff is unmodeled
audit_findings.magnitude: JAKAFI 2025 net sales were $3,092.5 million, 60.2% of $5,141.2 million total revenue; valuation impact unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: The expected post-2028 sales decline reduces future owner earnings and terminal earnings, but the model applies 0%, 3%, or 6% growth and no product-specific erosion.
audit_findings.evidence: However, we expect that JAKAFI product sales will begin to decline upon the expiration of our patent exclusivity in 2028.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated modeling omission, not merely a possible risk: the filing states that JAKAFI sales are expected to decline after exclusivity expires in 2028, while even the bear case holds owner earnings flat. The cliff begins within the explicit forecast period and affects a product representing 60.2% of 2025 revenue. Because terminal value supplies 47.7% to 51.5% of operating value, failing to reflect a durable earnings decline is reasonably capable of changing the $71.05-$90.75 per-share valuation range and the conclusion. The record does not provide the erosion rate, margins, or replacement earnings needed to quantify the valuation overstatement.
audit_findings.action: Rerun all scenarios with an explicit post-2028 JAKAFI erosion curve, product-level contribution margins, generic-entry timing from patent outcomes or settlements, and separately probability-weighted replacement earnings from JAKAFI XR, existing products, and pipeline assets; compare revised value per share and buy-below price with the current outputs.
